study.heading: Study

summary.paused: Paused — you can continue where you left off

study.start_intro: Due cards and a few new ones.
study.custom_intro: Studies the cards your filter picks.
study.practice_hint: Your answers don’t change the schedule.
study.end_label: Pause (continue later where you left off)

count.due_desc: Cards whose review is due today
count.learning_desc: Cards asked again at short intervals

study.suspend_desc: Don’t ask this card again until you bring it back
study.bury_desc: Don’t ask this card again today
study.hint_context: Fill the gap in the sentence

idle.title: What do you want to study?
idle.body: Pick a mode and what to study; every choice shows its count.
idle.off: The study module is off. You can turn it on in Settings › Modules.

waiting.title: Next card in {n, plural, one {# min} other {# min}}
waiting.body: The remaining cards come back after a short break. Wait, study something else, or finish for now.

launcher.title: Study
launcher.mode_label: How do you want to study?

kind_desc.normal: Flip the card and say how well you knew it; that sets when it comes back.
kind_desc.learn: Asks multiple choice first, then written; cards you get right move on in the schedule.
kind_desc.test: A mixed paper (multiple choice, written, matching) with a score at the end. Doesn’t change the schedule.
kind_desc.match: Match words with their meanings against the clock. Doesn’t change the schedule.
kind_desc.quiz: One word, four options; pick one and see the right answer at once. Practice: doesn’t change the schedule.

scope_desc.due: Due reviews and today’s new cards
scope_desc.new: Cards you have never studied, within the daily limit
scope_desc.struggled_today: Cards you rated “Again” or got wrong today
scope_desc.all_decks: Every card in all your decks

empty.no_cards: This deck has no cards yet
empty.daily_limit: Today's card limit is reached (new card and review limits)

launcher.practice_desc: Study today’s cards without touching the schedule.
launcher.custom_note: A filter is set in Options: it picks the cards.
launcher.no_modes: No study mode is on. Turn one on in Settings › Modules.
launcher.legend: Schedule = when you see a word again. In modes that “change schedule” your answers set it; “practice” modes never touch it, so play as much as you like.

sched.affects: Changes your schedule: your answers set the next review
sched.practice_mode: Practice: your schedule stays the same
sched.practice_switch: Practice (switched on in Advanced): your schedule stays the same

exam_kind_desc.multiple_choice: You get the word and pick its meaning.
exam_kind_desc.written: You get the meaning and type the word.
exam_kind_desc.matching: Match four words with four meanings (counts as one question).
exam_kind_desc.true_false: Off by default: guessing gets half right, so it teaches little.

launcher.exam_no_kinds: Pick at least one question type
launcher.advanced_desc: Card count, practice, time limit, filter, postpone
launcher.query_desc: Filter by tag, level or a search (e.g. level:B1).
launcher.postpone_desc: No time today? Move what is due a few days ahead.

normal.name: Cards
normal.description: Flip the card and say how well you knew it; that sets when it comes back.

quiz.name: Test
quiz.description: One word, four options; you see the right answer as soon as you pick.

learn.name: Learn
learn.description: Step by step: pick the meaning, then type it yourself; it comes back until you know it.

test.name: Exam
test.description: A paper of mixed questions with a score at the end.

match.name: Match
match.description: Match words with their meanings against the clock.

new_per_session.label: New cards per session
new_per_session.description: How many new cards a normal session introduces (0 = none).

type_answer.label: Type the answer
type_answer.description: Show an input and check what you type.

answer_buttons.label: Answer buttons
answer_buttons.description: Two buttons or all four with intervals.

auto_grade.label: Rate automatically
auto_grade.description: Use the checker's suggestion as the rating.

day_start_hour.label: Next day starts at
day_start_hour.description: Local hour when a new study day begins.

learn_ahead_mins.label: Show learning cards early (minutes)
learn_ahead_mins.description: When nothing else is left, a learning card whose step is almost up comes up to this many minutes early, so you don't wait for nothing. If you would have to wait longer, you see "Next card in …". 0: always wait until the step is up.

keep_typed_answers.label: Keep what you type
keep_typed_answers.description: On: what you type on a card, in Learn's written stage and in the Exam's written questions is kept with the review (the last 20 per card), so when you fix a hard card you see what you got wrong. It goes into backups, never into logs. Off: nothing new is kept; answers kept before stay.

conflict.not_current_card: This card is no longer in the session.
conflict.nothing_to_study: There is nothing to study here right now.
